Title: Data Analyst III
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Esta vacante está siendo ofertada por Principal Afore SA de CV ¿Qué esperamos de ti? En Principal creemos que el futuro financiero se construye con decisiones informadas y centradas en las personas. Estamos buscando a nuestro siguiente Data Analyst III en nuestro equipo de Business Intelligence y Analítica. En esta posición podrás: Desarrollar y mantener soluciones de Business Intelligence y Analytics que transformen datos en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones. Diseñar dashboards, KPIs y modelos de datos, así como automatizar procesos analíticos y de reportería, entendiendo y aterrizando las necesidades del negocio. Realizar análisis estadísticos y evaluar iniciativas de negocio para identificar oportunidades, tendencias e impactos. Conectar con el negocio, entender sus necesidades y traducir conceptos técnicos y análisis complejos en mensajes claros, accionables y orientados a resultados. Gestionar entregables analíticos de principio a fin, trabajando de forma cercana con áreas de Negocio, Datos y Tecnología. Asegurar la calidad, consistencia y confiabilidad de la información utilizada en las soluciones analíticas. ¿Qué buscamos? Licenciatura o ingeniería en Actuaría, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Finanzas, Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos, Negocios o área afín. 3 a 5 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data Analysis o posiciones relacionadas. Experiencia con Power BI (deseable), SQL, DAX, Power Query y Excel avanzado. Conocimientos de modelado y transformación de datos, estadística descriptiva e inferencial, pruebas de hipótesis y diseño de experimentos. R y/o Python deseable, así como conocimientos de Azure, automatización e IA aplicada. Inglés intermedio Nuestra Cultura de Trabajo Somos conscientes que un adecuado equilibrio es la mejor forma de tener equipos exitosos y empoderados, por lo cual adoptamos un enfoque de flexibilidad que se adapta a tus necesidades y de tu equipo con base en una cultura de confianza. Nuestro compromiso es entregarte los recursos y oportunidades que necesitas para ser exitoso. ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? ¡Flexibilidad! Modalidad de Trabajo híbrido con vestimenta flexible y espacios colaborativos. Más tiempo para ti: los viernes trabajamos hasta las 3:00 p.m. y además podrás tener días adicionales a tus vacaciones al año. Un paquete de Compensación Integral con prestaciones superiores a la ley y beneficios que promueven tu seguridad financiera, como: SGMM, seguro de vida, plan privado de pensión, programa de compra de acciones, vales de despensa, una app de consultas ilimitadas con médicos, nutriólogos y psicólogos, etc. Oportunidades y herramientas para impulsar tu desarrollo profesional. Una comunidad con una cultura de colaboración que prioriza la diversidad, equidad e inclusión y nuestros valores. Experiencia Principal En Principal, valoramos el balance tanto a nivel personal como profesional. Juntos, estamos imaginando un futuro orientado a darle propósito a los servicios financieros, y eso comienza contigo. Nuestro éxito depende de las experiencias y talentos únicos de nuestros colaboradores apoyándolos de la misma manera que a nuestros clientes; con ofertas de beneficios integrales y competitivas diseñadas para proteger su bienestar físico, financiero y social. Visita nuestro sitio de carreras para obtener más información sobre nuestro propósito, valores y beneficios. Información adicional Buscamos una persona con pensamiento analítico, orientación a negocio y autonomía, capaz de convertir problemas o necesidades de negocio en soluciones basadas en datos. Es importante contar con capacidad para manejar múltiples prioridades, cuestionar supuestos, comunicar insights de manera clara a diferentes audiencias y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Challenges for the Students Understanding and translating real business problems into data driven solutions. Working with complex, large scale datasets and ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability. Generating tangible business value. Developing analytical solutions that go beyond experimentation, considering scalability, maintainability, and usability. Collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary, global team and adapting to agile ways of working. Applying modern data science best practices, including reproducibility, documentation, and code quality. Learning and using an enterprise grade data science stack Main Responsibilities And Activities To Be Carried Out Process, clean, and validate data, ensuring data quality and reliability for analytical and modeling purposes. Conduct exploratory data analysis to generate insights and support decision‑making through analytical outputs and visualizations. Formulate hypotheses, design analytical approaches, and apply statistical techniques to validate results. Perform feature engineering and data preparation to support predictive and prescriptive modeling efforts. Develop, evaluate, and iterate on predictive or prescriptive models using machine learning or other advanced AI techniques. Contribute to the full lifecycle of Data Science solutions, including documentation, validation, and preparation for production deployment. Apply Data Science and Software Engineering best practices, including reproducibility, version control, and clear technical documentation. Required Specific Requirements / Qualifications Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to break down complex business problems into structured analytical tasks. Proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, reusable, and well structured code for data analysis and modeling. Solid knowledge of SQL. Ability to communicate insights effectively through data storytelling, using clear analysis and visual outputs. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively within a team oriented, agile environment. High level of attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving. English proficiency sufficient for technical and professional communication in a global team. Familiarity with version control tools (e.g., Git). Nice to Have Familiarity with Snowflake or other analytical data warehouses. Knowledge of web applications development REST APIs, HTML and/or CSS. Knowledge or practical experience in simulation techniques (e.g., discrete‑event simulation, Monte Carlo simulation). Knowledge or practical experience in optimization methods, such as linear, integer, or nonlinear optimization, heuristics, or metaheuristics. Familiarity with optimization or simulation libraries/tools (e.g., OR‑Tools, PuLP, Gurobi, CPLEX, SimPy, or similar). Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Exposure to AI models beyond academic coursework. Experience working with enterprise grade data platforms or cloud based analytical environments. (Azure, AWS, etc.)

Title: Data Modeling
Description: About the job HCLTech is a global technology company, home to more than 218,000 people across 59 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2024 totaled $13.7 billion. Skills: Hard Skills: Data Modeling, Snowflake DB (SQL), ReactJS Soft Skills: Communication, Innovation & Creativity, Problem Solving, Resilience & Adaptability, Teamwork & Collaboration. Resource Description: We are looking for a Data Engineer with a Front-End Development profile who combines strong data management capabilities ( SQL, Snowflake, Power BI ) with hands-on experience developing multi-module React applications . This person will leverage Artificial Intelligence tools to accelerate code generation, collaborate within a team using version control, and participate in the integration of advanced analytics services, including Snowflake Cortex AI . Requirements Key Responsibilities: Develop and maintain multi-module React applications , ensuring a scalable, clean, and well-documented architecture. Use Generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar solutions to accelerate code writing, refactoring, and code reviews. Manage the complete deployment lifecycle of React applications, including builds, semantic versioning, packaging, deployment across environments (development, staging, and production), and CI/CD configuration . Design and optimize complex SQL queries in Snowflake , including data modeling for analytical consumption and front-end interfaces. Integrate Power BI Datasets through REST APIs to expose processed data to corporate dashboards and reports. Explore and implement use cases using Snowflake Cortex AI , including built-in ML capabilities, LLM functions, sentiment analysis, summarization, and search capabilities over data stored in Snowflake. Actively collaborate with the team using Git , including branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews, and participate in Agile ceremonies. Responsibilities / Mandatory Requirements 3+ years of experience in React development , including hooks, context, routing, and state management with Redux or Zustand. Proven experience deploying multi-module React applications , including micro-frontends, monorepos (Nx, Turborepo), or modular architectures using lazy loading and code splitting. Strong knowledge of Git version control , including branching models (GitFlow or trunk-based development), conflict resolution, release tags, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. Advanced SQL skills , including CTEs, window functions, complex joins, query optimization, and handling semi-structured data such as JSON/Variant. Hands-on experience with Snowflake , including warehouses, stages, tasks, streams, roles and permissions, cloning, and Time Travel. Knowledge of Power BI and API integrations , including push datasets, refresh endpoints, embedding, or direct connectivity from Snowflake. Experience using AI-powered code-generation tools as part of daily development workflows, with the ability to validate, refine, and ensure the quality of AI-generated output. Strong collaboration skills, including clear communication, documentation of technical decisions, and openness to code reviews . Preferred Qualifications / Highly Valued Skills: Experience with Snowflake Cortex AI , including functions such as CORTEX.COMPLETE(), CORTEX.SUMMARIZE(), CORTEX.SENTIMENT(), and CORTEX.SEARCH(), as well as experience creating semantic search services or RAG solutions using data stored in Snowflake. Knowledge of Snowpark (Python or Java) for data processing within Snowflake. Experience using TypeScript in enterprise-scale React projects. Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress . Knowledge of containers (Docker) and basic orchestration for application deployment. Experience building middleware APIs using Node.js or FastAPI to serve as a bridge between Snowflake/Power BI and front-end applications. We offer a competitive package that includes Life insurance Major Medical Expenses Insurance Minor Medical Expense Insurance Savings Fund Food vouchers 30 days as Christmas Bonus 12 days of vacation in the first year, increasing 2 days as dictated by law. Additionally, we provide continuous training and development opportunities to help our employees achieve their professional goals. We need Fluent English FGVC
